description: Multiple-choice questions generated from one small cluster of the concept graph.

options.description: Exactly 4 answer texts, without letters, of similar length. Wrong options are plausible mistakes from the same cluster, not silly and not from other topics.

correct_index.description: Index (0 to 3) of the correct option.

explanation.description: Why the correct option is right and, briefly, why a common wrong option is not. Written like a teacher, pointing to the page. Never mentions a graph and never refers to options by position (options get reordered).

concept_ids.description: ids of the concepts this question tests, taken from the input cluster.

uses_relation.description: True only if answering needs the link between two concepts (order, part-of, contrast), not just one definition.

source_file.description: File name from the input that supports the answer.

source_page.description: Page number from the input that supports the answer.
